_readme: One object per project. 'logo' (optional) is the client's logo file, shown on the home card; 'logo_bg' is the tile color behind it (sampled from the logo's own background, or a neutral off-white for transparent logos). Officers may change either. Optional 'logo_offset' {x, y} nudges the logo by a fraction of its own rendered size so its artwork is optically centred when the file has uneven built-in margins on an opaque background (positive = right/down); transparent files are trimmed to symmetric margins instead (e.g. productspacelogo-trimmed.png). Fields marked null or [TBD] are unknown and MUST render as visible placeholders, never invented. 'fits' is a suggested mapping of majors/interests to the work, inferred from the scope of work; the club should correct it to match who actually worked on each project. No individual client contacts are stored here on purpose.

projects.title: Alliom
projects.tagline: Predicting housing values at the zip-code level with machine learning.
projects.summary: Alliom aims to develop machine learning models that address inefficiencies in the stratified housing market by predicting property values at a granular level (for example, by zip code).
projects.challenge: The housing market is stratified, and broad averages hide what is happening in specific neighborhoods. Alliom wants models that predict property values at a much finer level.
projects.scope_detail: The project refines two forecasting models (a time-series model and an LSTM), brings in professionals for technical guidance, and develops business strategies for monetization and legal compliance.
projects.approach: [TBD: how the team actually worked, tools, methods, cadence]

projects.title: School Harbor
projects.tagline: Rebuilding a student test-score dashboard on a cloud SQL database and Looker Studio.
projects.summary: The project replicates an existing Tableau dashboard that visualizes student test scores over time, segmented by demographics and aggregated at school-district and state levels.
projects.challenge: School Harbor needed its student test-score reporting reproduced in a different toolchain while keeping the same level of detail: scores over time, split by demographics, rolled up to district and state.
projects.scope_detail: Data is managed in a Google SQL database and visualized in Google Looker Studio to give a Tableau-like experience. The work includes configuring the database, connecting it to Looker Studio, and potentially using Python for sub-tasks.

projects.title: Product Space
projects.tagline: Helping a brand-new product-design org scale its outreach and plan for turnover.
projects.summary: Product Space gives UMD students a way to explore product design, apply their skills on real-world projects, and build a professional network. As a new organization with a 5-member board and an inaugural cohort of 9 members, it needed support streamlining client outreach, benchmarking best practices, and planning for growth and turnover.
projects.challenge: A new organization needs repeatable processes before it grows: how to reach clients, what good looks like elsewhere, and how to hand off smoothly as leaders graduate.
projects.scope_detail: The team built an outreach process, benchmarked best practices from comparable organizations, and documented a timeline and process flow to manage growth and turnover.

projects.title: UMD Dynamic Dance
projects.tagline: Operations, knowledge management and marketing for a 25-member hip-hop dance team.
projects.summary: UMD Dynamic Dance is a hip-hop dance team with 25 members and a 7-8 member E-Board. It asked for support improving administrative efficiency, knowledge management and marketing.
projects.challenge: A busy, growing team needs clear roles, documentation that survives leadership changes, and a marketing approach that strengthens its campus presence and external outreach.
projects.scope_detail: The project focuses on role delegation, streamlining documentation and communication processes, and refining the team's marketing approach.

projects.title: SCG Internal Project
projects.tagline: Turning the lens on ourselves: engagement, quality and operations.
projects.summary: An internal SCG project addressing member engagement, performance quality and operational efficiency.
projects.challenge: Improve how senior members stay involved, raise the quality of work and presentations, and streamline internal procedures across recruitment, onboarding and client acquisition.
projects.scope_detail: The team identifies solutions for senior-member involvement, work and presentation quality, and internal procedures from recruitment through client acquisition.
